title: Fund pharmacist treatment of minor conditions through Medicare where it works
action: Evaluate the state programs that let pharmacists treat uncomplicated urinary tract infections and other low-risk conditions, and where the benefits are shown, fund the service through Medicare or the PBS on the same basis as a GP visit and extend it to further low-risk conditions.
why: Letting pharmacists treat simple conditions frees GP time for complex care and saves patients a separate visit; without Medicare or PBS funding, patients pay more and uptake stays low.

evidence.source: 5-year Productivity Inquiry: Advancing Prosperity, Recommendations and Reform Directives
evidence.quote: State and Territory Governments should undertake trials for expanded scope of practice in health services where supported by evidence.

evidence.source: 5-year Productivity Inquiry: Advancing Prosperity, Recommendations and Reform Directives
evidence.quote: The Australian Government should ensure that the novel arrangements that are the subject of these trials are given equivalent funding through the Medicare Benefits Schedule or the Pharmaceutical Benefits Scheme, where the benefits are substantiated.
